SERVICE_CONTEXT.service_summary: If you're like me and will be 24 or older in the semester you transfer, then you will be considered an independent when you file your FAFSA ([source](https://studentaid.gov/sites/default/files/fafsa-dependency.pdf)) and ; One last point: I dropped out of high school for reasons unrelated to academics, but before I did I also had no idea what I wanted to major in if I were to attend college. It took me years to figure out that I loved math; Time is valuable, but that doesn't mean you should rush
